source: Beginner short story written in spoken Israeli Hebrew by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.en: In summer we go to the sea.
The water is warm and the sand is very hot.

sentences.ar: אני שוחה קצת ואחר כך שוכב בשמש.
sentences.en: I swim a bit and then lie in the sun.
The children build a castle out of sand.
We eat and drink cold water.
In the evening we go home tired.
